parts.label: (c)
parts.answer: The component equations are inconsistent, so the lines do not intersect.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Express a general point of $AB$ or $l$ in component form, for example $(2-\lambda,1-3\lambda,1+\lambda)$ or $(1+\mu,2-3\mu,-3-2\mu)$. B1. Equate at least two pairs of components and solve for $\lambda$ or $\mu$. M1. Obtain a correct value from a pair, for example $\lambda=6,\frac13,-\frac{14}{9}$ or $\mu=-5,\frac23,-\frac{11}{9}$. A1. Verify that all three component equations are not satisfied and conclude that the lines do not intersect. A1. The printed scheme also lists the alternative parameterisation $(1-\lambda^*,-2-3\lambda^*,2+\lambda^*)$ or $(1+\mu^*,2-3\mu^*,-3-2\mu^*)$. Total 4.
